status: Desktop overflow focus defect reproduced and fixed locally; hosted acceptance pending. Original overflow and hydration timeouts remain unexplained.

historicalFindings.finding: WebKit retained More after widening to 1600 pixels.
historicalFindings.review: Original log reconfirms the 5000 ms count assertion. No original overflow artifact is returned by the current run-artifacts endpoint. Existing recorded trace observations remain historical evidence.
Original stack locates the timeout in the legacy-heading alias navigation loop. It records no failing URL or browser cause; existing current diagnostics add both URL and failure state.

reproducedDefect.trigger: A desktop resize commits a different More-menu layout while focus restoration is queued; the user then focuses content/branding or clicks non-focusable page content.
reproducedDefect.cause: The queued callback captured a target and restored it unconditionally; existing cancellation guarded breakpoint restoration but not desktop overflow restoration.
reproducedDefect.fix: Read live overflow intent in the callback; cancel it on new focus or an outside pointer choice; preserve a currently visible focus destination and restore without scrolling.

baseline.failureStage: All twelve failures are the final focus assertion, after both layout and user-choice preconditions pass.
baseline.controls: Ordinary navigation restoration and reciprocal resize cases pass.
